note: v3384: Konyo said the fleet still was not working. What closes it is that the capability is VERSIONED: v3379 taught the console to mint a mask from the banked hand-over, so a machine on v3379 or later can publish item names with no board window at all. fleet_compare now forwards the peer version and whether it can publish, and the panel prefers that reason over the sentence the peer wrote. An absent or unparseable version stays UNKNOWN and is never called out of date. 9 cases, 4 red-proofs PROVEN, 495 gates, plus a heart row in all four registries counting how many peers are below the bar.
